title: no tooltip only values
name: No tooltip only values — NSW
rule: No tooltip-only values — hover is not the values channel (keyboard/touch/AT). Dual-cite empty/failure “don’t hide the only message in a dismissible overlay.”
pass_when: Values are available without hover (labels, table, or equivalent).
fail_when: The only values are in a hover tooltip.
overview: Chart values must be available without hover tooltips alone.
apply_when: Exposing numeric values on charts for keyboard, touch, and AT users.
not_when: Values available only inside a hover tooltip.
agent_hint: Expose values via labels, table, or equivalent—never tooltip-only.
description: No tooltip-only values—hover is not the values channel for keyboard, touch, or assistive technology. Related empty or failure guidance: do not hide the only message in a dismissible overlay. Pass when values are available without hover via labels, table, or equivalent. Fail when the only values live in a hover tooltip, blocking non-hover access to the numbers.
do_not_claim: Chart anatomy table as a substitute that drops this hover ban.
